title: the grid bounces on the beat and the sun cracks open on the drop
story: Willie Bounce at 117 BPM but felt at 58 (autocorrelation lag 33 ticks), so the bounce lands on each beat and the camera moves every two bars. The pre-roll keeps the sun low and the grid calm; each kick bobs the camera and each snare flashes the sun. The build from bar 54 climbs the grid's perturbacion and the sun while the kick shake escalates bar by bar. At 3606 the camera drops low to the grid, perturbacion slams and the hue steps; after it the same kick and snare carriers settle into camera stations every two bars, with the four loudest hits punching zoom and flash.
